title: Look It Up: Multi-bit LLM Watermarking via Codebook Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.16890v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Attributing short LLM-generated texts to a specific source remains challenging for existing multi-bit watermarking methods, which often require long generations or costly decoding to recover payloads reliably. We propose a codebook-based watermarking scheme that maps an $n$-bit payload to a longer $u$-bit codeword and embeds it during generation through token-level logit biasing. During extraction, the received bit sequence is matched to the nearest codeword in a precomputed secret codebook using Hamming or Levenshtein distance. Experiments show that our method achieves near-perfect recovery for 16-24 bit payloads on 200-token generations and strong performance on 127-token generations for base models. Results are weaker on some instruction-tuned models with very short texts, where low-entropy output distributions reduce embedding reliability. translated_title: 查阅即得：基于码本搜索的多比特大语言模型水印
translated_abstract: 对于现有多比特水印方法而言，将较短的大语言模型生成文本归因到特定来源仍然具有挑战性，因为这些方法通常需要较长的生成文本或高昂的解码开销才能可靠地恢复负载信息。我们提出了一种基于码本的水印方案，该方案将 n 比特负载映射为更长的 u 比特码字，并通过词元级的 logit 偏置在生成过程中将其嵌入文本。在提取阶段，接收到的比特序列使用汉明距离或莱文斯坦距离与预计算的密钥码本中最近的码字进行匹配。实验表明，对于基础模型，我们的方法在 200 个词元的生成文本上对 16-24 比特负载实现了近乎完美的恢复，在 127 个词元的生成文本上也表现强劲。在一些指令微调模型生成的极短文本上效果较弱，因为低熵的输出分布降低了嵌入的可靠性。我们还研究了一种基于 BCH 码的变体，它无需存储码本，但通常会降低鲁棒性。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于码本搜索的多比特大语言模型水印方案，通过将短负载映射为更长码字并在提取时进行纠错匹配，显著提升了对短文本负载的恢复能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a codebook-based multi-bit LLM watermarking scheme that maps short payloads to longer codewords with error-correcting nearest-neighbor search, enabling near-perfect payload recovery from short generated texts.
